name: Nitrogen (Fixed)—Ammonia, Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026
notes: One-page USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries chapter on fixed nitrogen/ammonia with world production and reserves by country (US 13,600 to 14,000 kt; China 49,000 kt; India 15,000 kt; Malaysia 1,500 kt) and plant closures. USGS-authored material is US public domain. Evidence: https://pubs.usgs.gov/periodicals/mcs2026/mcs2026-nitrogen.pdf (read 2026-11-17).
